objective: Implement a local settings reader with a separately testable command-line adapter.
acceptance: The command reads valid settings and reports malformed input clearly.
The integrated behavior preserves the documented command contract.
constraints: Synthetic controller example only; no deployment or live model invocation.
parallel_reason: Both components use the declared settings interface and independent fixtures. They own disjoint files and do not consume each other's unfinished output.

external_inputs.settings_interface: The reader returns an object for valid input and a typed error for malformed input; the adapter prints either result.

components.objective: Implement the settings reader and its behavioral checks.
acceptance: Valid and malformed settings are checked against the declared interface.

components.objective: Implement the command adapter against an interface-compatible fixture.
acceptance: Arguments and reader errors produce the documented command output.

integration.objective: Connect the accepted components, check the combined command and provide usage notes.
acceptance: The actual components work together on valid and malformed input.
The handover documents invocation and verified limitations.
